findings.title: ShinyHunters Exploits Oracle PeopleSoft Zero-Day (CVE-2026-35273) to Trigger Extortion
findings.summary_md: Reported that Oracle PeopleSoft zero-day CVE-2026-35273 was exploited by ShinyHunters before Oracle's June 10 advisory, exposing data and triggering extortion attacks. This places the group's PeopleSoft operation four months before the FBI breach claim.

findings.title: Oracle PeopleSoft Zero-Day Vulnerability (CVE-2026-35273) Exploited by ShinyHunters | eSentire
findings.summary_md: Vendor-side advisory noting Oracle disclosed a critical unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability in Oracle PeopleSoft PeopleTools on June 10, 2026, tracked as CVE-2026-35273 with a CVSS score of 9.8, and already exploited by ShinyHunters.

findings.title: ShinyHunters claims FBI hack, data theft in PeopleSoft zero-day breach
findings.summary_md: ShinyHunters told BleepingComputer it used the PeopleTools zero-day for remote code execution on the night of Monday, September 21, reached FBI-managed AWS GovCloud infrastructure, and stole a claimed 2TB to 3TB covering current and former employees, job applicants, and internal records. The group also claimed compromise of FBI Criminal Justice, HR, and Medlink services, and said it was exploiting the same flaw against Fortune 500 companies.

findings.title: ShinyHunters Claims FBI Breach, Says It Stole Data on Agents and Job Applicants
findings.summary_md: Covered the group's claim that it breached the FBI and stole employee data, with the bureau stating it was investigating unauthorized activity affecting FBIjobs.gov, its recruitment portal.

findings.title: Cybercriminal group claims it stole FBI personnel and applicant data
findings.summary_md: CBS News reported the group's claim, made in posted communications, that it breached the FBI on Monday and stole data about personnel and job applicants. Early mainstream confirmation that the claim predates the October detention reporting.

findings.title: ShinyHunters Renewed Mass Exploitation Campaign Targeting Oracle PeopleSoft
findings.summary_md: Mandiant and Google Threat Intelligence Group reported renewed mass exploitation of CVE-2026-35273 by UNC6240 (ShinyHunters), after the June zero-day window of May 27 to June 9, 2026 that hit higher education hardest. The actor bypassed WAF rules blocking the Environment Management Hub endpoint by URL-encoding a single character, requesting /%50SEMHUB/ instead of /PSEMHUB/, and the renewed wave spans higher education, technology, IT services, healthcare, agriculture, transportation, and government.
